443-4279-6094--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-4279-6094--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1844-3752-8193.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 8.
1844-3752-8193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Phage.
1844-3752-8193.description:
Donate control of Avacyn to an opponent using Fateful Handoff.
Kill Phage by any method.
At the beginning of the next end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Phage from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

728-5702-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6151.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6151.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3532-5078-6769-7753.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6769-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-3240-6351-6462.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-5789-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-5789-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

152-4050-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven multicolored permanents.
152-4050-6741.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Robots, adding {7}.
Repeat.

339-677-4050-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3110-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3110-5078-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-2897-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Gigantoplasm.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Gigantoplasm by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1387-1500-2633-2871-4146.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel and Murmuring Mystic trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Murmuring Mystic trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

2105-4050-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4050-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1753-2615-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
1753-2615-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

813-2103-3556.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Flicker.
813-2103-3556.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2585-3767-3918-4875.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
2585-3767-3918-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
2585-3767-3918-4875.description:
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

488-2895-3200-4211-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Tormod's Crypt or Urza's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-2895-3200-4211-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3129-5189-5231-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3129-5189-5231-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting two +1/+1 counters on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {R}.
Repeat.

4871-5256-5695-5752.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Brokkos's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia four times by sacrificing four Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Saprolings' power.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 3.

360-1981-2584.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
360-1981-2584.description:
Cast Soul Warden by paying {W}.
When Soul Warden enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Pandemonium and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat from step 3.

824-2464-3062.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
824-2464-3062.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from target creature and putting two +1/+1 counters on a different creature due to Pir.
Repeat.

579-1185-1818-1852-2308.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
579-1185-1818-1852-2308.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Healer of the Pride triggers, holding priority, activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {2}.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 3 life due to Knight of Dawn's Light.
Prize Pig and Trudge Garden trigger.
Resolve the Prize Pig trigger, putting three ribbon counters of Prize Pig, then removing all ribbon counters from Prize Pig and untapping it.
Resolve the Trudge Garden trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

3750-4050-4689.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least four experience counters.
3750-4050-4689.description:
Declare Otharri as an attacker.
Otharri triggers, causing you to get an experience counter and create at least five 2/2 Rebel creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Rebels, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

944-1939-3613-4050.description:
Cast Lunarch Veteran from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {W}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Lunarch Phantom.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lunarch Phantom, adding {W}.
Because Dress Down causes Lunarch Phantom to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Lunarch Veteran.
Repeat.
